title: 谷歌 CEO 怎样向员工宣布一个艰难决定（2023）
topic: 谷歌 CEO 怎样向员工宣布一个艰难决定（2023）

source.title: A difficult decision to set us up for the future
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 基于 Google CEO 2023 年发给员工的邮件；人数和支持安排均为当时邮件中的历史信息。
paragraphs: Sundar sent the following email to Google employees earlier today.

I have some difficult news to share. We’ve decided to reduce our workforce by approximately 12,000 roles. We’ve already sent a separate email to employees in the US who are affected. In other countries, this process will take longer due to local laws and practices.

This will mean saying goodbye to some incredibly talented people we worked hard to hire and have loved working with. I’m deeply sorry for that. The fact that these changes will impact the lives of Googlers weighs heavily on me, and I take full responsibility for the decisions that led us here.
Over the past two years we’ve seen periods of dramatic growth. To match and fuel that growth, we hired for a different economic reality than the one we face today.

I am confident about the huge opportunity in front of us thanks to the strength of our mission, the value of our products and services, and our early investments in AI. To fully capture it, we’ll need to make tough choices. So, we’ve undertaken a rigorous review across product areas and functions to ensure that our people and roles are aligned with our highest priorities as a company. The roles we’re eliminating reflect the outcome of that review. They cut across Alphabet, product areas, functions, levels and regions.
translations: 桑达尔今天早些时候向谷歌员工发送了以下电子邮件。
我有一些艰难的消息要分享。我们决定裁员约12000个职位。我们已经向受影响的美国员工发送了单独的电子邮件。在其他国家，由于当地法律和惯例，这个过程将需要更长的时间。
这意味着我们将要告别一些我们努力招聘并一直很享受与他们共事的极具才华的人。对此我深感抱歉。这些变化将影响谷歌员工的生活这一事实让我深感沉重，我为导致我们做出这些决定负全部责任。
在过去的两年里，我们经历了快速增长时期。为了匹配并推动这种增长，我们招聘时所依据的经济现实与今天我们所面临的现实不同。
我对我们面前巨大的机遇充满信心，这得益于我们使命的力量、我们产品和服务的价值，以及我们在人工智能方面的早期投资。为了充分把握这一机遇，我们需要做出艰难的选择。因此，我们对各个产品领域和职能部门进行了严格的审查，以确保我们的人员和职位与我们作为公司的最高优先事项保持一致。我们正在裁减的职位反映了这次审查的结果。这些裁员涉及Alphabet、产品领域、职能部门、级别和地区。
fullTextParagraphs: Sundar sent the following email to Google employees earlier today.

I have some difficult news to share. We’ve decided to reduce our workforce by approximately 12,000 roles. We’ve already sent a separate email to employees in the US who are affected. In other countries, this process will take longer due to local laws and practices.

This will mean saying goodbye to some incredibly talented people we worked hard to hire and have loved working with. I’m deeply sorry for that. The fact that these changes will impact the lives of Googlers weighs heavily on me, and I take full responsibility for the decisions that led us here.
Over the past two years we’ve seen periods of dramatic growth. To match and fuel that growth, we hired for a different economic reality than the one we face today.

I am confident about the huge opportunity in front of us thanks to the strength of our mission, the value of our products and services, and our early investments in AI. To fully capture it, we’ll need to make tough choices. So, we’ve undertaken a rigorous review across product areas and functions to ensure that our people and roles are aligned with our highest priorities as a company. The roles we’re eliminating reflect the outcome of that review. They cut across Alphabet, product areas, functions, levels and regions.
To the Googlers who are leaving us: Thank you for working so hard to help people and businesses everywhere. Your contributions have been invaluable and we are grateful for them.
While this transition won’t be easy, we’re going to support employees as they look for their next opportunity.
We’ll pay employees during the full notification period (minimum 60 days).
We’ll also offer a severance package starting at 16 weeks salary plus two weeks for every additional year at Google, and accelerate at least 16 weeks of GSU vesting.
We’ll pay 2022 bonuses and remaining vacation time.
We’ll be offering 6 months of healthcare, job placement services, and immigration support for those affected.
Outside the US, we’ll support employees in line with local practices.

As an almost 25-year-old company, we’re bound to go through difficult economic cycles. These are important moments to sharpen our focus, reengineer our cost base, and direct our talent and capital to our highest priorities.
Being constrained in some areas allows us to bet big on others. Pivoting the company to be AI-first years ago led to groundbreaking advances across our businesses and the whole industry.

Thanks to those early investments, Google’s products are better than ever. And we’re getting ready to share some entirely new experiences for users, developers and businesses, too. We have a substantial opportunity in front of us with AI across our products and are prepared to approach it boldly and responsibly.

All this work is a continuation of the “healthy disregard for the impossible” that’s been core to our culture from the beginning. When I look around Google today, I see that same spirit and energy driving our efforts. That’s why I remain optimistic about our ability to deliver on our mission, even on our toughest days. Today is certainly one of them.

I’m sure you have many questions about how we’ll move forward. We’ll be organizing a town hall on Monday. Check your calendar for details. Until then, please take good care of yourselves as you absorb this difficult news. As part of that, if you are just starting your work day, please feel free to work from home today.

notes.meaning: 桑达尔发送了以下电子邮件
notes.explain: 这是一个正式通知的开场白，表明这是一封正式的公司内部邮件
notes.example: The CEO sent the following email to all shareholders regarding the quarterly earnings report.

notes.phrase: reduce our workforce by approximately 12,000 roles
notes.meaning: 将我们的员工规模减少约12,000个职位
notes.explain: 这是企业裁员的专业表达方式，使用'workforce'和'roles'比直接说'fire employees'更为委婉正式
notes.example: The company plans to reduce its workforce by 5% over the next two quarters to optimize operational costs.

notes.explain: 表达对重要决定带来的情感负担，显示领导者的同理心和责任感
notes.example: The decision to close the factory weighs heavily on me, as it will affect many loyal employees who have worked here for decades.

notes.explain: 表示决策过程是经过深思熟虑和系统性分析的，增加了决定的合理性和可信度
notes.example: Before implementing the new strategy, the management team has undertaken a rigorous review of market research and competitive analysis.

scenario.title: Summarizing a difficult workforce announcement
english: You are discussing Sundar Pichai’s 2023 message to Google employees.

The email announced a workforce reduction of approximately 12,000 roles. Pichai said he took responsibility for the decisions that led to it, apologized for the impact, and described support for affected employees.
Your task is to summarize the announcement without changing its scale, inventing a reason, or promising benefits beyond what the message states.
chinese: 你正在讨论 Sundar Pichai 于 2023 年发给 Google 员工的邮件。
邮件宣布将减少约 12,000 个岗位。Pichai 表示自己为导致这一决定的选择承担责任，对受到的影响致歉，并介绍了对受影响员工的支持。
你的任务是在不改动规模、不编造原因、不添加邮件未承诺的福利的前提下概括公告。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请用英文概括 Google CEO 2023 年邮件中的裁员规模，并说明他如何回应这一决定。数字和态度以原文为准。
firstAttempt.sample: Google announced that it would eliminate about 12,000 roles. Sundar Pichai said he took responsibility for the decisions that led to the cuts and apologized for the impact.
firstAttempt.rationale: 准确保留约 12,000 个岗位、承担责任和为影响道歉这几项信息。

words.collocation: reduce the workforce, expand the workforce, skilled workforce
words.example: The company had to downsize its workforce due to economic challenges.
words.translation: 公司因经济挑战不得不缩减其员工规模。
words.note: workforce通常指组织或行业的全体员工，比employees更正式，常用于商业语境。

words.example: The project will be completed approximately by the end of next month.
words.translation: 该项目大约在下个月底完成。
words.note: approximately比about更正式，常用于商业报告和官方声明中。

words.collocation: highly talented, talented employees, talented individuals
words.example: Our company is committed to attracting and retaining the most talented professionals in the industry.
words.translation: 我们公司致力于吸引和留住行业内最有才华的专业人士。
words.note: talented强调天生的能力或技能，常用于描述员工或团队成员。

words.collocation: economic reality, harsh reality, new reality
words.example: The company had to adapt to the new reality of remote work after the pandemic.
words.translation: 疫情后，公司不得不适应远程工作的新现实。
words.note: reality在这里指客观存在的经济状况，与预期或计划形成对比。

words.collocation: top priorities, strategic priorities, set priorities
words.example: Our team has identified three key priorities for the upcoming quarter.
words.translation: 我们团队已确定了下一季度的三个关键优先事项。
words.note: priorities是priority的复数形式，指按重要性排序的事项列表。

words.collocation: cut across departments, cut across regions, cut across levels
words.example: The new policy cuts across all departments and will affect every employee in the organization.
words.translation: 新政策横跨所有部门，将影响组织中的每位员工。
words.note: cut across表示影响或涉及多个不同的类别、部门或领域，强调广泛性。

structure.original: In other countries, this process will take longer due to local laws and practices.
analysis: 介词短语'In other countries'作为地点状语，置于句首，表明动作发生的地点范围
主句'this process will take longer'使用将来时，表示'这个过程将花费更长时间'，其中'this process'是主语，'will take longer'是谓语部分
介词短语'due to local laws and practices'作为原因状语，解释为什么过程会花费更长时间，其中'due to'表示原因，'local laws and practices'是介词宾语
structure.transfer: In other regions, this process may take longer because local rules differ.

rewrite.bad: We will eliminate about 200 positions because the economy is difficult.
rewrite.good: We’ve decided to reduce our workforce by approximately 12,000 roles. I take full responsibility for the decisions that led us here, and I’m deeply sorry for the impact.
rewrite.translation: 我们决定减少约 12,000 个岗位。我为导致这一结果的决定承担全部责任，也对造成的影响深感抱歉。
rewrite.pattern: We’ve decided to [decision] by approximately [verified scale]. I take responsibility for [decision] and am sorry for [impact].

cloze.prompt: Google announced that it would eliminate about 12,000 ___.
cloze.why: roles 指岗位；保留 about，准确呈现“约 12,000 个”。

cloze.prompt: He took responsibility ___ the decisions that led to the cuts.
cloze.why: take responsibility for 是固定搭配。

cloze.prompt: He apologized for the ___ of the cuts.
cloze.why: apologize for the impact 表达对决定后果的歉意。

dictation.why: 听清句中的工作任务、动作和时间信息。

dictation.text: The announcement must balance transparency with maintaining employee morale while adhering to legal requirements and avoiding panic in the workplace.
dictation.why: 听清句中的工作任务、动作和时间信息。

translationPractice.prompt: Google 宣布将裁减约 12,000 个岗位。
translationPractice.answer: Google announced that it would eliminate about 12,000 roles.
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“eliminate about 12,000 roles”在准确概括公告中的裁员规模时的用法。

translationPractice.prompt: Sundar Pichai 表示，他为导致裁员的决定承担责任。
translationPractice.answer: Sundar Pichai said he took responsibility for the decisions that led to the cuts.
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“take responsibility for…”在说明负责人承担相应责任时的用法。

choice.prompt: 请用英文概括 Google CEO 2023 年邮件中的裁员规模，并写出他如何承担责任。数字和态度要以原文为准。
options: Google announced about 200 role reductions and said the CEO was not responsible for the decision.
Google announced a workforce reduction of approximately 12,000 roles. Sundar Pichai said he took full responsibility for the decisions that led to it and apologized for the impact.
The email promised every affected employee a new permanent role.
choice.why: 准确保留 approximately 12,000 roles，以及承担责任和致歉这两个信息；不要改写成其他人数或自行补充原因。

output.prompt: 新经理需要在内部简报中说明 Google 2023 年裁员公告中的两个信息：受影响岗位规模，以及 CEO 对决策承担了什么责任。请用英文简洁写出这两点。
output.sample: Google announced plans to eliminate about 12,000 roles in 2023. Sundar Pichai said he took responsibility for the decisions behind the cuts and apologized for their impact.
check: 是否准确概括 CEO 承担责任并道歉？
是否没有加入原文未确认的解释？
